title: ScsRelationshipRegistrationRequest
description: SCS-CAP-02 ScsRelationshipRegistrationRequest (contract 9a3e978). Not in the request, because the system sets them: relationshipId, schemaVersion, claimedAt, verificationStatus (CLAIMED_UNVERIFIED), lifecycleStatus (ACTIVE), representationVersion ("1" until the contract defines it), createdAt and createdBy. A registration never supersedes another relationship. Rules that span fields (OTHER description, validity period, claiming party, framework scope) are checked by the capability so that the contract's failure codes are returned.

otherRelationshipTypeDescription.description: Required exactly when relationshipType is OTHER.

commodityScope.description: Each value must equal the scope.commodityCode of a referenced framework.

geographicScope.description: Each value must equal the scope.countryOfOrigin of a referenced framework.

frameworkAssociationIds.description: CAP-01 frameworkIds; at least one, each ACTIVE.

validUntil.description: When given with validFrom, must be after it.

claimedByPartyId.description: One of the two parties: fromPartyId or toPartyId.
